description: Fixed tenant-isolation registry fragment for Arena & League v2 authority. This fragment is explicitly allowlisted by the canonical tenant coverage gate and protected-recovery policy; every proven row names a PostgreSQL negative test that mentions the registered table.

tables.isolationModel: Every season is owned by tenant_id + workspace_id, composite-FK bound to platform_workspaces, and uniquely identified by tenant/workspace/season_key and tenant/workspace/config_digest. Lifecycle/configuration mutations are guarded in PostgreSQL, finalized seasons are immutable, public table privileges are revoked, and ENABLE+FORCE RLS fails ordinary unscoped access closed. The server authority always loads a season by id together with the acting tenant/workspace scope, so a foreign season id resolves as not found rather than crossing the boundary.

Each enrollment repeats season tenant_id + workspace_id and is composite-FK bound to that exact scoped season plus the exact active student principal binding. Enrollment uniqueness includes tenant/workspace/season/student, insertion is admitted only while the scoped season is inside its configured enrollment window, terminal withdrawal/disqualification evidence is immutable, public table privileges are revoked, and ENABLE+FORCE RLS fails ordinary unscoped access closed.
